integrity: Exact proof from plane-graph bipartiteness, supplementary opposite angles in cyclic quadrilaterals, and vertex angle sums; the square parity corollary was also checked over all eight even-total boundary parity patterns.
scientific_limitations: Finite edge-to-edge tilings of simply connected Euclidean polygons only; T-junction dissections are excluded. The square parity condition is necessary, not sufficient, and no rectangle classification is claimed.
title: A boundary-angle balance for cyclic quadrangulations of polygons
